sections.body: DNA is a double helix made of four bases (A, T, C, G). A always pairs with T, and C with G. The sequence of bases codes for proteins.
You inherit one copy of each gene from each parent. Versions of genes are called ALLELES. A DOMINANT allele shows its effect even with just one copy; a RECESSIVE one needs two copies.
ECOLOGY studies how organisms interact with each other and their environment: food webs, competition and nutrient cycles.

quiz.q: In DNA, adenine (A) always pairs with…
hints: C pairs with G. What's left for A?
If one strand is C-C-G, the other is G-G-C.
quiz.explain: A pairs with T (and C pairs with G).

quiz.q: Two parents each carry one recessive allele for a trait (but don't show it). What's the chance their child shows the trait?
hints: Draw a Punnett square: Aa × Aa.
Which combination has two recessive alleles?
The four outcomes are AA, Aa, aA, aa. Only one has two recessive copies.
quiz.explain: Only aa shows the trait: 1 out of 4 outcomes.
